newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Panorama Res sets A$17 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Panorama Res sets A$17 mln placement.

text.p: Australian gold and base metal explorer Panorama Resources NL said it will raise up to A$19.55 million through a brokered private placement to major North American, European and Australian institutions.

The placement will comprise 6.4 million ordinary shares at A$0.50 each and 27.6 million special warrants at A$0.50 each, convertible to ordinary shares following shareholder approval, to raise A$17 million, it said.
But Panorama said there will also be a "greenshoe" option for 15 percent oversubscriptions to raise another A$2.55 million.
Canadian investment bank Nesbitt Burns Inc will act as the agent to the issue, Panorama said.
Panorama's executive chairman Bruce Walsham said the placement was a significant step forward for the company.
"We can now plan our programmes for the next two to three years and plan to meet meet our prime objective of becoming a substantial gold producer," he said in a statement.

"These funds, together with the conversion of options which should raise A$6 million over the next 15 months, means that Panorama is in excellent position to proceed with our projects in Kenya, Congo and Western Australia," Walsham said.
"The placement also represents a significant show of support for the company's extensive exploration portfolio."
Walsham said the company's gold exploration in Kenya and the preliminary work in the Congo Republic is seen as very encouraging.
"Today's funding announcement means we will be able to pursue these projects towards an anticipated decision to mine," he said.
Panorama listed in Vancouver two months ago.
Its shares closed unchanged at 58 cents on Monday.
